blogs.title: Mining Math from the Web: How DeepSeekMath Built a 120‑Billion‑Token Corpus
blogs.description: Explore how the authors turned the noisy Common Crawl archive into a high‑quality mathematical dataset using a fastText classifier, iterative domain filtering, deduplication and multilingual cleaning. Learn why web data can rival curated sources and how this massive corpus powers their model.

blogs.title: From Code to Calculus: Why Starting with a Coder Model Supercharges Math Reasoning
blogs.description: Dive into the surprising boost that pre‑training on source code gives to mathematical problem solving. The post explains experiments comparing code‑first versus general pre‑training, outlines how algorithmic thinking transfers to step‑by‑step reasoning and tool‑assisted calculations.

blogs.title: Teaching LLMs to Think Like Mathematicians: Chain‑of‑Thought, Program‑of‑Thought & Tool Integration
blogs.description: Break down the three instruction‑tuning paradigms used in DeepSeekMath—plain chain‑of‑thought explanations, program‑of‑thought Python solutions, and hybrid tool­integrated reasoning. Realistic examples show how each style improves accuracy across English and Chinese benchmarks.

blogs.title: Group Relative Policy Optimization: A Leaner Way to Reinforce Math Skills
blogs.description: Introduce GRPO, the new reinforcement‑learning algorithm that drops the costly critic model in PPO. Learn how grouping sampled outputs creates a baseline for advantage estimation, saves memory, and pushes MATH benchmark scores higher while staying easy to implement.

blogs.title: Open‑Source Math Mastery: How DeepSeekMath Rivals GPT‑4 on the MATH Benchmark
blogs.description: Summarize the headline results—51.7 % accuracy on competition–level MATH without external tools—and compare them against closed models like GPT‑4 and Gemini Ultra as well as older open models such as Minerva 540B. Discuss what this means for the accessibility of high‑performing AI.

blogs.title: Crossing Language Barriers: Boosting Chinese Math Reasoning with DeepSeekMath
blogs.description: Explain how including Chinese webpages in the training set produced sizable gains on MGSM‑zh, CMATH and Gaokao benchmarks. The article highlights multilingual data selection tricks and why language diversity matters for worldwide educational AI applications.

blogs.title: A Unified Lens on Fine‑Tuning & Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
blogs.description: Walk readers through the paper’s framework that unifies SFT, RFT, DPO, PPO and GRPO under three components—data source, reward function and algorithm. The post clarifies why reinforcement learning improves Maj@K rather than Pass@K scores and points toward future robust RL directions.
